description: Expected results for the official Daisy tutorial setup sample/test.dai ('Simulation for use in tutorial.', Andeby farm: sandy soil column, Taastrup weather, 1986-12-01 to 1988-04-01, plowing + mineral N, spring barley with under-sown grass, barley harvest, autumn N, grass cut). inputs/ are the unmodified files from git HEAD of github.com/daisy-model/daisy (commit a621e3b). The repo ships NO reference output for this setup, so the values were recorded from a clean run of the server binary through the KI's tools/run_daisy.py; two clean runs gave identical .dlf and checkpoint files (apart from the RUN: time stamp line), so the run is deterministic. Also checked: run exit code 0 and the 'Program finished' line in daisy.log.
engine_version: Daisy 7.1.4 (binary built Mar 25 2026 from github.com/daisy-model/daisy commit a621e3b)

numeric_checks.name: n_dlf_files
numeric_checks.why: the setup asks for 6 .dlf logs (harvest, sbarley, field/soil water, field/soil nitrogen)

numeric_checks.name: n_harvest_rows
numeric_checks.why: two harvest events: spring barley harvest and the grass cut

numeric_checks.name: barley_harvest_doy
numeric_checks.why: barley harvested 1987-08-26 (day 238), when DS reached 2.0 before the 9-5 fallback date

numeric_checks.name: barley_grain_DM
numeric_checks.why: spring barley grain (storage organ) dry matter at harvest, Mg DM/ha

numeric_checks.name: barley_stem_DM
numeric_checks.why: spring barley stem dry matter removed at harvest, Mg DM/ha

numeric_checks.name: barley_grain_N
numeric_checks.why: N in harvested barley grain, kg N/ha

numeric_checks.name: grass_cut_leaf_DM
numeric_checks.why: grass leaf dry matter taken at the 1987-10-10 cut, Mg DM/ha

numeric_checks.name: barley_max_LAI
numeric_checks.why: peak spring barley leaf area index, m2/m2

numeric_checks.name: precip_total_mm
numeric_checks.why: sum of monthly precipitation read from dk-taastrup.dwf (input passes through)

numeric_checks.name: actual_ET_total_mm
numeric_checks.why: sum of monthly actual evapotranspiration, mm

numeric_checks.name: matrix_percolation_total_mm
numeric_checks.why: sum of monthly matrix percolation out of the logged zone, mm

numeric_checks.name: final_soil_matrix_water_mm
numeric_checks.why: soil matrix water at the last monthly row (1988-04-01), mm

numeric_checks.name: matrix_N_leaching_total
numeric_checks.why: sum of monthly matrix N leaching, kg N/ha

numeric_checks.name: crop_N_uptake_total
numeric_checks.why: sum of monthly crop N uptake (barley + grass), kg N/ha

numeric_checks.name: n_balance_lines
numeric_checks.why: Daisy's own end-of-run balance summaries written to daisy.log (N and water)

numeric_checks.name: max_abs_balance_error
numeric_checks.why: largest |In - Out - Increase| in those summaries; Daisy prints 0.0 / 0.000, i.e. water and N balances close

recorded_with: /mnt/disk1/Hydrocraft_server/models/Daisy/bin/daisy (7.1.4) with DAISYHOME=/mnt/disk1/Hydrocraft_server/models/Daisy/source/repo, run via KI tools/run_daisy.py, read via KI tools/parse_daisy_output.py
reference: own run (no official reference output ships with sample/test.dai); run twice, identical results
notes: Tolerances are small and only allow for print rounding on other builds; this build repeats exactly. Sums are over the monthly rows of field_water.dlf / field_nitrogen.dlf (first row is the 1986-12-01 initial state, all zeros).
